batch_norm: Frozen running statistics. Encoder trainable only in encoder-replay.
augmentation: Horizontal flips, normalized-space gain0.9..1.1 and offset-0.1..0.1. No synthetic balls.
selection: Mean of original-validation F1 and teacher-development F1, then fewer combined false positives; threshold ties prefer higher threshold, epoch ties prefer earlier epoch. Report both variants.
split_policy: Use original training split only; exclude any same-recording original training sample atframe>=2694. Original validation images that overlap teacher test/development frames are excluded. Teacher split unchanged.
scope: Post-test exploratory follow-up after frozen-head failure; previously opened later teacher and150transfer checks are not independent tests. No automatic replay change.
